E4_family.form: P(H) = rho(H) * P_bar, rho piecewise-constant, jumps at declared head thresholds
E4_family.range: P in [0, P_bar]  (rho=0 admitted => full cessation is IN the family)

sources: BSEACD Mgmt Plan 2022 (amended 2024-08-15), Table 1-1 Mandatory Drought Curtailments
Smith et al. 2013, BSEACD RI 2013-1201 (Drought Trigger Methodology)
USFWS ECOS fdoc_3055 (HCP annual report), Table 1
BSEACD_family.state_variables: Barton Springs flow Q (cfs) AND Lovelady head H_L (ft-msl)
BSEACD_family.trigger_rule: 10-day running averages; ENTER a stage if EITHER crosses; EXIT only if BOTH recover
BSEACD_family.form: P = rho(stage) * P_authorized, rho piecewise-constant in stage
BSEACD_family.conditional_permits: up to 100% cessation (rho = 0) in deep stages

comparison.shared_form: BOTH are multiplicative piecewise-constant reductions off an authorized baseline, with jumps at declared trigger levels, and BOTH admit rho=0 (full cessation). E4 cpm cuts 20/30/35/40 vs BSEACD 20/30/40/50 - same shape, 4 mandatory steps.

differences.issue: two trigger variables (Q and H_L) vs E4's single H
differences.effect: BSEACD rules are P=f(Q,H_L); E4's family cannot express them

differences.issue: hysteresis: enter on EITHER, exit only on BOTH
differences.effect: rule is path-dependent, not a memoryless function of current state

differences.issue: curtailment is off *authorized permit volume*, not off realized pumpage
differences.effect: P_bar must be defined as authorized baseline, else cuts are not comparable

verdict_B_half.why: The margin lemma bounds H_{t+1} = a H_t + alpha + beta F + gamma P_t <= a H_t + alpha + beta F for ANY non-negative pumping SEQUENCE (gamma<0). Domination by the zero-pumping trajectory plus contraction (0<a<1) gives limsup H_t <= H*_0 < K. The argument never refers to a rule's functional form, so it subsumes two-variable (D1) and path-dependent/hysteretic (D2) rules. E4-negative* is therefore family-free even against BSEACD's strict superset.

verdict_C_half.why: Construction is family-relative. BSEACD's family is a strict SUPERSET of E4's (D1, D2), so an unrestricted construction could succeed using a rule E4 never admitted - which by this memo's own rule is NOT a generalization of E4.
verdict_C_half.restriction: Define the v3 declared family as the E4-COMPARABLE SUBFAMILY: single-state-variable, memoryless, piecewise-constant multiplicative cuts at the declared BSEACD trigger levels (20/30/40/50% at Q = 38/20/14/10 cfs for the springflow spec; at H_L = 478.4/462.7/457.1/453.4 ft-msl for the head spec), plus flat_rho members. This is a SUBSET of what BSEACD actually has, so a positive result is CONSERVATIVE and comparable to E4.
verdict_C_half.consequence_if_violated: Report as a BSEACD policy finding, NOT as a generalization of E4.

gate2_status: RESOLVED: B unconditional; C conditional on the E4-comparable subfamily restriction
